rationale.oversight-explanation: Decision Bank, rationales, code links, and test summaries improve human understanding.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Executable tests deterministically check implementation behavior against recorded decisions.
rationale.ai-review: An LLM planner translates human decisions into implementation-checking test suites.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Traceable decision tests detect implementation departures from programmer intent.
rationale.automation-bias: Capable programmers passively approved agent plans and misunderstood resulting implementations.
rationale.quality-debt: Study measures cognitive debt through programmer–implementation mental-model mismatches.
